beats.label: S1 · Blaviken
beats.text: Geralt refuses to choose between mage Stregobor and cursed princess Renfri; he kills Renfri to stop her massacre, and her dying words name a girl in the forest as his destiny.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the destiny thread that binds Geralt to Ciri, the show's central premise.

beats.label: S1 · Yennefer remade
beats.text: Yennefer, a quarter-elf hunchback, undergoes agonising transformation for beauty at Aretuza — costing her fertility — and takes an advisor's post at the court of Aedirn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Yennefer, her lost fertility, and the price of her power — all of which drive her later choices.

beats.label: S1 · Law of Surprise
beats.text: At Pavetta's betrothal, cursed Duny claims her via the Law of Surprise; grateful for Geralt's help, he owes him whatever he does not yet know he has — Pavetta's unborn child, Ciri.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The invocation that ties Ciri to Geralt as a Child of Surprise, the legal-magical bond the show turns on.

beats.label: S1 · The djinn wish
beats.text: Chasing a djinn, Geralt secretly wishes his fate bound to Yennefer's to save her life; she leaves him once she realises she cannot tell what she feels from what he wished for.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks the Geralt–Yennefer bond as a destiny question, the wound they carry into every later season.

beats.label: S1 · Cintra falls
beats.text: Nilfgaard sacks Cintra and breaches the castle; Ciri flees into the countryside, hunted across the wreckage by the Nilfgaardian officer Cahir for her latent power.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Displaces Ciri and puts Nilfgaard on her trail — the pursuit that will drive every remaining season.

beats.label: S1 · Brotherhood splits
beats.text: Ordered to stay neutral by the Brotherhood, Tissaia, Yennefer, Vilgefortz and a small band of mages defy the vote and ride to Sodden Hill to hold the North's last line.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marks the fracture inside the Brotherhood and introduces Vilgefortz as a champion of the North — a mask he will keep for two more seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Sodden and reunion
beats.text: At Sodden, Yennefer unleashes a wall of fire that annihilates Nilfgaard's army and vanishes; Geralt, wounded, finally finds Ciri in the woods and she asks who Yennefer is.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with the three leads' fates locked together — Ciri found, Yen presumed lost — the exact posture S2 opens in.

cliffhanger.text: Geralt has Ciri at last, but Yennefer has vanished after burning Nilfgaard's army at Sodden and the North has only just held. Nilfgaard's hunt for Ciri has barely begun.
questions: Is Yennefer alive after Sodden Hill?
Why does Nilfgaard want Ciri so badly?
What powers keep detonating out of Ciri when she panics?

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.line: A Witcher who spent decades avoiding destiny; he now has Ciri, the Child of Surprise he tried to refuse.

characters.name: Cirilla "Ciri" of Cintra
characters.line: Cintran princess orphaned by Nilfgaard's invasion; carries a latent power that erupts when she is threatened.

characters.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
characters.line: Powerful sorceress and Geralt's on-and-off lover; disappeared after unleashing a wave of fire that broke Nilfgaard at Sodden.

characters.name: Jaskier
characters.line: Bard and Geralt's travelling companion; abandoned on a mountainside after Geralt blamed him for his misfortunes.

characters.name: Tissaia de Vries
characters.line: Rectoress of Aretuza and Yennefer's mentor; broke Brotherhood neutrality to lead the mages at Sodden.

characters.name: Vilgefortz
characters.line: Ambitious young sorcerer who rallied the mages against Nilfgaard; exposed at Sodden as a Nilfgaardian turncoat after losing to Cahir.

characters.name: Cahir
characters.line: Nilfgaardian officer obsessed with capturing Ciri; still on her trail after the fall of Cintra.

characters.name: Fringilla Vigo
characters.line: Nilfgaardian mage sent in Yennefer's place; commanded the losing army at Sodden and answers for the defeat.

beats.label: S2 · Kaer Morhen
beats.text: Geralt brings Ciri to his witcher home Kaer Morhen; a monstrous transformation forces him to kill his brother Eskel, and he agrees to train Ciri to fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Ciri's new home and Geralt's shift from reluctant protector to active teacher.

beats.label: S2 · Deathless bargain
beats.text: Stripped of her magic after Sodden and secretly imprisoned, Yennefer accepts the Deathless Mother's bargain — deliver Ciri, and her power will return.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Yennefer against Ciri and creates the betrayal the season turns on.

beats.label: S2 · Elder blood
beats.text: Vesemir discovers Ciri carries the long-lost Elder blood, coveted as mutagen for new witchers; the fire-mage Rience begins hunting her for an unseen master.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals what Ciri actually is and introduces Rience — the visible end of a conspiracy that runs into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Elves and a murdered baby
beats.text: Nilfgaard shelters the elves under sorceress Francesca, who bears the first elven child in decades; Emhyr then murders the baby to drive the grieving elves onto the warpath.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the elven alliance with Nilfgaard and Francesca's grief-fuelled hunt for Ciri as the elves' saviour.

beats.label: S2 · The betrayal breaks
beats.text: Yennefer reunites with Geralt and Ciri and tries to hand Ciri to Voleth Meir, but relents; Francesca's grief over her murdered baby frees the demon to possess Ciri instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Yennefer's arc of betrayal and directly triggers the season's climax.

beats.label: S2 · Kaer Morhen bleeds
beats.text: Possessed, Ciri kills several witchers before Yennefer offers her own body as a host; Ciri teleports the three into another world, where the Wild Hunt reaches for her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New enemy on the horizon and confirmation that Ciri's power crosses worlds.

beats.label: S2 · Emhyr revealed
beats.text: In Cintra, Emperor Emhyr is unmasked as Duny — Ciri's own father — and Tissaia quietly tells the sorcerer Vilgefortz that Ciri carries the Elder blood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The double reveal that arms S3: Nilfgaard's obsession is paternal, and Vilgefortz now knows the prize.

cliffhanger.text: Ciri, Geralt and Yennefer are together on the road with a bounty on Ciri's head from the North, Nilfgaard, the elves, Rience's master and the Wild Hunt. Emhyr wants his daughter back and Vilgefortz now knows exactly what she is.
questions: Why does Emperor Emhyr want the daughter he abandoned?
What does the Wild Hunt intend to do with Ciri?

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.line: Openly Ciri's guardian; leaving Kaer Morhen with her because every faction on the Continent now wants her.

characters.name: Cirilla "Ciri" of Cintra
characters.line: Confirmed Elder-blood heir; briefly possessed by the Deathless Mother, and can teleport across worlds under strain.

characters.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
characters.line: Magic restored; forgiven by Geralt and Ciri after nearly trading Ciri away, and back at their side.

characters.name: Emhyr var Emreis
characters.line: White Flame of Nilfgaard, revealed as Ciri's father Duny; personally directing the hunt for her.

characters.name: Vilgefortz
characters.line: Still trusted as a Northern hero, but now secretly knows Ciri carries the Elder blood.

characters.name: Rience
characters.line: Fire mage hunting Ciri for an unnamed master; still at large after Kaer Morhen.

characters.name: Francesca Findabair
characters.line: Elven sorceress whose newborn Emhyr murdered; now searching for Ciri as the prophesied elven saviour.

characters.name: Tissaia de Vries
characters.line: Aretuza's rectoress; unwittingly handed Vilgefortz the secret of Ciri's blood.

characters.name: Dijkstra and Philippa Eilhart
characters.line: Redania's spymaster and court mage; running a rival intelligence campaign to seize Ciri for King Vizimir.

beats.label: S3 · Rience's master
beats.text: After six months in hiding, Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri realise fire-mage Rience serves an unseen sorcerer, and set out for Aretuza to unmask him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the season's investigation and sends the trio to the school where everything will detonate.

beats.label: S3 · The conclave
beats.text: Yennefer convenes a conclave to unite the North against Nilfgaard; she and Geralt uncover evidence pointing at Stregobor, only to realise the real culprit is Vilgefortz.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whodunnit pivot of the season — the villain the audience thought was a Northern hero.

beats.label: S3 · Thanedd Coup
beats.text: Vilgefortz opens the school to Nilfgaardian and Scoia'tael forces; Aretuza is torn apart, and Geralt is broken in a duel with Vilgefortz while Ciri flees to the tower of Tor Lara.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The battle that shatters the Brotherhood, cripples Geralt, and separates Ciri from her family.

beats.label: S3 · Ciri in Korath
beats.text: Fleeing through a monolith at Tor Lara, Ciri lands in the Korath desert and survives alone on visions of the burned princess Falka, until bounty hunters find her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Physically strands Ciri far from Geralt and plants the Falka identity she will take up next.

beats.label: S3 · Redanian coup
beats.text: Philippa has King Vizimir assassinated and crowns Radovid, ending Dijkstra's grip on the throne; Jaskier, briefly Radovid's lover, is used and discarded.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rearranges the Northern power players Geralt and Ciri will run into for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S3 · Tissaia's end
beats.text: The remaining sorceresses vow to hunt Vilgefortz; Tissaia, guilt-crushed by his betrayal and the ruin of Aretuza, takes her own life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off the woman who held the Brotherhood together and clears the ground for Yennefer's Lodge.

beats.label: S3 · Ciri becomes Falka
beats.text: Emhyr's court welcomes a fake Ciri; the real Ciri, freed by an outlaw gang called the Rats, tells them her name is 'Falka' as Geralt heals in Brokilon and rides to find her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with three separate Ciris in play — the fake, the runaway 'Falka', and the daughter Emhyr still expects.

cliffhanger.text: The Brotherhood is destroyed, Vilgefortz has escaped, and Ciri is riding with the Rats under a stolen name while Geralt recovers alone in Brokilon. Emhyr is holding a fake daughter and does not yet know it.
questions: How long before Emhyr realises his 'Ciri' is an impostor?
How far will Ciri fall while calling herself Falka?
Can the surviving sorceresses stop Vilgefortz before he reaches Ciri?

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.line: Grievously wounded by Vilgefortz; recovering in Brokilon and setting out to find Ciri.

characters.name: Cirilla "Ciri" of Cintra
characters.line: Riding with the outlaw Rats under the name 'Falka'; hardening into someone Geralt would not recognise.

characters.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
characters.line: Leader-in-waiting of a new Lodge of Sorceresses formed from Aretuza's survivors, hunting Vilgefortz.

characters.name: Vilgefortz
characters.line: Exposed as the mastermind behind Rience and the missing elf-blooded students; at large and pursuing Ciri.

characters.name: Emhyr var Emreis
characters.line: Emperor of Nilfgaard; unknowingly hosting a doppelgänger of Ciri.

characters.name: Philippa Eilhart
characters.line: Kingmaker of Redania; has murdered Vizimir and installed Radovid to run the country from behind the throne.

characters.name: Radovid
characters.line: New King of Redania; broke with his lover Jaskier to take the crown.

characters.name: Dijkstra
characters.line: Displaced Redanian spymaster; sidelined by Philippa's coup and looking for leverage back into power.

characters.name: Jaskier
characters.line: Heartbroken by Radovid's betrayal; back at Geralt's side for the search.

characters.name: Cahir
characters.line: Changed sides in the chaos of Thanedd; helped Geralt and Ciri escape and is no longer Nilfgaard's man.

beats.label: S4 · A fellowship south
beats.text: Geralt, Jaskier and archer Milva head for Nilfgaard to save Ciri, gathering the dwarf Zoltan, the vampire barber-surgeon Regis and, uneasily, Cahir along the way.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Assembles the party that will carry the season's road-plot toward Ciri.

beats.label: S4 · Ciri with the Rats
beats.text: Ciri bonds with the outlaw Rats and their lover Mistle; her growing savagery draws the notice of the bounty hunter Leo Bonhart.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Ciri's descent and puts Bonhart — the season's real threat to her — on her trail.

beats.label: S4 · The Lodge forms
beats.text: Yennefer gathers Philippa, Fringilla and Francesca at the castle of Montecalvo to form a lodge of mages against Vilgefortz, who tortures Fringilla for their plans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the political-magical body opposing Vilgefortz and stages the coming siege.

beats.label: S4 · Redania breaks apart
beats.text: Dijkstra tortures Geralt to force Jaskier to break with Radovid; Radovid, now his own king, exiles Dijkstra rather than remain his puppet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits every Redanian player from every other, leaving no unified northern power to help against Vilgefortz.

beats.label: S4 · Emhyr is Duny
beats.text: Round a campfire Cahir reveals Emperor Emhyr's true face — the cursed Duny — and Geralt realises Emhyr means to marry his own daughter Ciri to fulfil a prophecy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Geralt finally understands the full horror driving Nilfgaard's hunt; it reshapes his mission from rescue to interdiction.

beats.label: S4 · Montecalvo holds
beats.text: The Lodge repels Vilgefortz's assault on Montecalvo and destroys his mage legion, but Vesemir and Margarita die in the fighting and Vilgefortz himself escapes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Vilgefortz's army without breaking Vilgefortz and kills the last father figure Geralt has.

beats.label: S4 · Bonhart takes Ciri
beats.text: Bonhart butchers the Rats and captures Ciri; Emhyr, desperate to secure the prophecy, unleashes a monster to hunt Geralt down before he can reach her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the final position — Ciri a prisoner, Geralt hunted — that the next season must resolve.

cliffhanger.text: Ciri is Bonhart's captive with the Rats slaughtered around her; Geralt's fellowship is closing on Nilfgaard while a monster of Emhyr's making hunts him. Vilgefortz has lost his army but not his obsession, and no one has reached Ciri yet.
questions: Will Bonhart deliver Ciri to Vilgefortz or to Emhyr?
Can Geralt survive Emhyr's monster long enough to reach her?
Now that Emhyr's prophecy demands his own daughter, will the Lodge move against him too?

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.line: Knighted in Rivia; leading his fellowship south with Emhyr's monster on his trail.

characters.name: Cirilla "Ciri" of Cintra
characters.line: Prisoner of the bounty hunter Bonhart after the Rats were massacred around her.

characters.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
characters.line: Founding voice of the Lodge; broke Vilgefortz's army at Montecalvo and is still hunting him.

characters.name: Emhyr var Emreis
characters.line: Nilfgaard's emperor and Ciri's father; will marry her to fulfil the prophecy and has set a monster on Geralt.

characters.name: Vilgefortz
characters.line: Fled Montecalvo alive but shorn of his legion; still fixated on Ciri.

characters.name: Leo Bonhart
characters.line: Feared bounty hunter who slaughtered the Rats and now owns Ciri as his captive.

characters.name: Cahir
characters.line: Fully integrated into Geralt's fellowship; the man who exposed Emhyr's true face.

characters.name: Jaskier
characters.line: Travelling with Geralt again after Dijkstra tortured Geralt into breaking his bond with Radovid.

characters.name: Milva and Regis
characters.line: Archer and vampire barber-surgeon who joined Geralt's road party; Milva is recovering from a miscarriage.

characters.name: Philippa, Dijkstra and Radovid
characters.line: Redania's three factions, now scattered — Radovid on the throne alone, Philippa in the Lodge, Dijkstra exiled.
